en: Uses per mission: unlimited or limited
zh: 每局任务次数：无限或有限

en: Unlimited, written as uses = {0} as in the imported Runtime project. HD2Runtime {1} and later read {0} as unlimited; older 0.30 releases refuse it, so the export requires HD2Runtime {1}. No value means unlimited on every 0.30 release.
zh: 无限，按导入的 Runtime 项目写为 uses = {0}。HD2Runtime {1} 及更高版本将 {0} 视为无限；较早的 0.30 版本会拒绝它，因此导出需要 HD2Runtime {1}。不写值在所有 0.30 版本中均表示无限。
comment: {0}: 0 or -1; {1}: the HD2Runtime version that accepts it (0.30.3)

en: Unlimited calls, written as uses = {0}: requires HD2Runtime {1} (no value is unlimited on every 0.30 release).
zh: 无限次呼叫，写为 uses = {0}：需要 HD2Runtime {1}（不写值在所有 0.30 版本中均表示无限）。
